newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iranian airline is to begin operating a weekly flight to Jeddah from Tehran soon, Iranian diplomat says.
- Israel frees portion of Palestinian funds.
- Yemeni cabinet to approve economic reforms on Wednesday.
- Sharjah in the United Arab Emirates exploits its gas reserves to attract local and foreign investment.
- Yemeni president meets opposition leaders in Sanaa to discuss the situation following last month's bombing in Aden.
- Ivory Coast invited the United Arab Emirates to invest in an oil refinery and an airline company.
- The United Arab Emirates' gross domestic product is expected to increase by 2.3 percent in 1998 to $40.3 billion from $39.4 billion this year.
